mapper.select: select * from coffeeMember order by mno desc
mapper.insert: insert into coffeeMember(mno, mid, mpasswd, mname, mbirth, mgender, mtel, memail, maddr, mzipno, mdate, mauthority) values(coffeeMember_seq.NEXTVAL, #{mid}, #{mpasswd}, #{mname}, #{mbirth}, #{mgender}, #{mtel}, #{memail}, #{maddr}, #{mzipno}, SYSDATE, 'USER')
